meta.name: design-guide
meta.description: Paperclip UI design system guide for building consistent, reusable frontend components. Use when creating new UI components, modifying existing ones, adding pages or features to the frontend, styling UI elements, or when you need to understand the design language and conventions. Covers: component creation, design tokens, typography, status/priority systems, composition patterns, and the /design-guide showcase page. Always use this skill alongside the frontend-design skill (for visual quality) and the web-design-guidelines skill (for web best practices).

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按照 Paperclip 设计系统的规范来创建和修改前端组件,使用规定的设计令牌、字体、状态颜色和组合模式,并确保新组件同步到 /design-guide 展示页。
howto.when: 当你要新建或改 UI 组件、给前端加页面或功能、调整界面样式,或想弄清设计语言时,它会接管。

say.text: 按 design-guide 规范新建一个状态徽章组件
say.note: Claude 会依据设计令牌和状态颜色创建组件并更新展示页。

say.text: 用 design-guide 的字体和颜色调整这个页面
say.note: 会应用规范中的排版和语义颜色。

say.text: 把新组件添加到 /design-guide 展示页
say.note: 确保新组件出现在设计指南中。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude builds or edits frontend components per the Paperclip design system, applying its tokens, typography, status colors and composition patterns, and keeps the /design-guide showcase updated.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create or modify UI components, add pages or features to the frontend, style UI elements, or need to understand the design language.

say_en.text: Create a status badge component following the design-guide.
say_en.note: Applies tokens and status colors, updates showcase.

say_en.text: Adjust this page's fonts and colors using design-guide.
say_en.note: Uses the defined typography and semantic colors.

say_en.text: Add the new component to the /design-guide page.
